name: flexera
description: Flexera One cost plugin for FinFocus. Actual cost comes from Bill Analysis costs/select. Recommendations come from the Optima recommendations index. Budgets are read from the Flexera budget index and budget report.

refreshToken.description: Flexera One refresh token. Provide this or both clientId and clientSecret.

clientId.description: Flexera One service account client id. Required with clientSecret when refreshToken is unset.

clientSecret.description: Flexera One service account client secret.

billingCenterIds.description: Billing center ids sent on every costs/select and forecasts/report call.

costMetric.description: Bill Analysis metric. Default is cost_amortized_unblended_adj.

apiToken.description: Legacy bearer token. Cost RPCs do not use it.

baseUrl.description: Flexera Optima API base URL (auto-configured from region if not provided)
